typingRules.fixedIdentifiers: Field-first typing preserves true IDs, codes, statuses, schemas, units, releases, hashes, locale tags and explicitly coded countries. Nested lists retain their nearest semantic parent and camelCase handles are recognized.
typingRules.foodNames: foodName receives the declared source-text locale for each national source. Existing data.names language keys are retained only when syntactically valid.
typingRules.otherHumanText: Unclassified human source text, including nutrient labels, legal licence titles, rights, country notices, portions and descriptive definitions, remains und rather than being assigned a country-derived language. Compact namespace definition handles and known SPDX shortcodes remain fixed identifiers.

scope: Curated public national composition records only. Foods and nutrient observations remain source-scoped; no cross-table food identity, quantity conversion, averaging, diet qualification or source-rights change is asserted.
nextQualification: The standalone package validation passed. The aggregation owner must include this immutable package in the paired core global proof before publication.
